articles.title: Partnerships & Stakeholders: Science and Technology Community
articles.description: The role of global science, academia, research and innovation is enshrined in the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction where it is recognized for the catalytic, boundary-pushing and transformative potential it holds for addressing the dynamic drivers of disaster risk.

articles.title: Early Warnings for All booklet
articles.description: The United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR) collaborated with the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) and partnered with COPE Disaster Champions to develop a child-friendly booklet on Early Warning Systems (EWS).

articles.title: Voices for resilience: integrating Indigenous knowledge into early warning systems
articles.description: Languages, the channels used, territorial references, community structures and Indigenous Peoples' own decision-making systems are all fundamental elements. So is recognizing the knowledge that communities already use.

articles.title: Arab youth turn lived experiences into practical solutions for disaster resilience
articles.description: More than 260 young leaders from across the Arab region participated virtually in the Regional Youth Resilience Lab.

articles.title: Statement on the Colombia Earthquake by Kamal Kishore, Special Representative of the UN Secretary-General for Disaster Risk Reduction and Head of UNDRR
articles.description: Statement on the Colombia Earthquake by Kamal Kishore, Special Representative of the UN Secretary-General for Disaster Risk Reduction and Head of UNDRR

articles.title: UNDRR at UNCCD COP17
articles.description: UNDRR takes part in the 17th session of the Conference of the Parties to the UN Convention to Combat Desertification, in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia, with five side events on drought risk, ecosystem loss and damage, water-related disasters and early warning.
